name: Row-difference projection for AMR cells
definition: An exact projection method for rotated AMR cells that projects them along pixel rows using row-difference accumulation, replacing a separate per-pixel exact path. This handles cells truncated by depth ranges and unit cubes used for interpolation tables.
summary: Row-difference projection is an exact rendering method for rotated AMR cells that uses row-difference accumulation and the divergence theorem to eliminate general clipped-polytope calculations and separate exact paths.
